plotEn:
No Pain (Italian: Nessun dolore) is a 2026 Italian drama film directed by Gianni Amelio, co-written with Ludovica Rampoldi. It stars Alessandro Borghi, Valeria Golino and Valerio Mastandrea.
The film had its world premiere out of competition at the 83rd Venice International Film Festival on 3 September 2026. It was theatrically released in Italy by 01 Distribution on 24 September.
